cells.gaps: The one usable fact is from 2021 and says stations often lack the technology to write reports on a computer, which is short of saying every station records on paper; it names no system, no count of stations and no place. EGY-001 to EGY-003 are from the excluded source and set nothing, so the Digital Justice Platform is not established; governance and the last twelve months are not held. Parent ruling: the one admissible fact (2021) says stations often lack the means to write reports on a computer, which is short of a statement that stations record on paper only.
